package sandbox

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/llm/safecall"
	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/polarisagi/polaris/pkg/types"
)

// WithPurpose("") 形式上声明了、实际记为 unspecified。
func selftestEmptyPurpose(ctx context.Context, p protocol.Provider) {
	_, _ = safecall.Infer(ctx, p, nil, types.WithPurpose(""), types.WithThinkingMode(types.ThinkingLow))
}
